nodes.label: Captain Lysandra Ironveil
nodes.description: Lysandra travels north with the group through gathering storms, and when the young rider Private Hester arrives carrying sealed reports for Mirathorn, Lysandra requests a report right away. Hester scoffs at the group's plan to head into the swamp, telling Lysandra they would need a much bigger party, and advises her to speak to Commander Vale first. Lysandra is in much better spirits once the group has a goal, opening up to Ephanna about how poorly she is handling the mission she has been given — upset at how hard it is to keep Mirathorn out of trouble but determined to get back to being the group leader. Stafl later casts Suggestion on her to learn her true intentions, and she answers that her goal is to keep the team focused on going to the swamp and destroying the source of the cult. At the guards' wall she is prompted forward as the group's leader, and the guard turns out to be her own father, who still calls her little Lysandra — she corrects him that she is Lieutenant Lysandra now.
